en.answer: In that case, the remaining targets are still returned to the hand.
en.question:
The effect of <<7549>> was activated targeting 2 or 3 cards.

If at the time of the resolution 1 of the targets is no longer on the field as a result of a card being activated in a chain, how does this resolve?
en.title: The effect of <<7549>> was activated targeting 2 or 3 cards.  If at the time of the resolution 1 of the targets is no longer on the field as a result of a card being activated in a chain, how does this resolve?

ja.answer: 2枚または3枚のカードを対象として、「<<7549>>」の効果を発動している場合、その効果処理時に、対象に選択したカードの内1枚がフィールドに存在しなくなっていたとしても、残りの選択したカードは通常通り手札に戻ります。
